title: i18n(service-messaging): ship the notification objects and digest heading in zh-Hant, ar, fr and pt-BR (第 5 包的 A 半)
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgBxjikPH2bUin9o95gbAxsx)_

Refs #30512 — **第 5 包的 A 半** (package 5 of 11, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, first half: `zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`). The B half (`ru`, `de`, `ko`) follows as its own PR; the card stays open until the last PR of the series flips the bundle check to the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 消息/通知七个对象（收件箱、回执、投递、偏好、模板、HTTP 投递、用户设备）的名称、字段、选项、帮助和视图名，以及摘要标题「您有 {{count}} 条通知」，补上繁中、阿语、法语、巴葡 4 种。这是第 5 包的 A 半；俄、德、韩在 B 半。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表（#29428 裁决 F）要求 11 种语言；本包整包超过 3000 行，按席位裁决按语言拆成 A/B 两半，各自单独可绿。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，`messages.ts` 的语言类型只加宽到这 4 种（B 半再加 3 种）；不动逻辑、schema、接口，原有 4 种一字未改。三处测试改动都是**前提变了、不是放宽**（见下文）。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/translations/index.ts`、`messages.ts`（阿语摘要标题用计数式写法，避开复数变化），再看 `keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=messaging` 输出 in sync；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Four new locales for the messaging objects under the platform locale table's tags: each a `TAG.objects.generated.ts` with all 203 object leaves plus its `TAG.source-hashes.generated.ts`, written by the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes`, served through `withSourceFallback`, `zh-CN` ahead of `zh-Hant` in `index.ts`.
- `messages.ts`: the digest heading in the four locales; `MessagingLocale` widens to eight tags (the B half widens it to eleven), so each half is green on its own.
- The extract command lists the four tags and its merge baseline imports the four bundles, so `check:i18n` covers them from this PR on.

## Test changes — the premise moved, nothing loosened

- `keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts` used `fr-FR` as its recipient with no pack. With `fr` shipping, that premise is false for French: the no-pack recipient and deployment default become `it-IT` (Italian is not a platform-table language) with the same assertions, including the single warning, and a new case pins a `fr-FR` recipient reading the `fr` heading (`Vous avez 2 notifications`).
- `admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts` and `setup-list-empty-states.test.ts` list the bundles they hold to their wording rules; the four new bundles join that list, so the rules now also cover them.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans and identifiers byte-identical, checked per leaf against `en`. Arabic is RTL prose with identifiers in Latin script. `t()` selects no plural form, so the Arabic digest heading is a tally (`عدد الإشعارات لديك: {{count}}`), correct for every count; the comment in `messages.ts` says why.
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose:** product and protocol names `APNs`, `FCM`, `Android`, `iOS`, and one help leaf that is a list of status codes, in every locale; beyond those, native words only: `fr` `Notifications`, `Partition`, `Source`, `Version`, `Web`; `pt-BR` `Status`, `Web`. `pt-BR` writes the payload as `Carga útil` rather than the English loanword.
- No cross-locale coincidence: `check:i18n-stale-fill` passes with the baseline untouched.
